task.title: Add a later family
task.shortdesc: Make a family for a person who is already in the tree, such as a daughter who marries.

prereq.p: Add both partners to the tree first. shows how.

context.p: Charlotte Brontë is already in the tree, as a child in her parents' family. In 1854 she married Arthur Bell Nicholls. This page makes that second family. Charlotte then shows in both: as a child, and as a partner. The sample tree already has this family, so use this page for people you added yourself.

step.cmd: Open the page of Charlotte Brontë, then choose at the top.
Scroll to the part named . Choose , then choose .

stepresult.p: The family form opens. Charlotte is already in the box . The picture shows the same form for another family, with Maria Branwell chosen as the second partner.

step.cmd: Select the box and type Arthur Bell.

stepresult.p: A list appears under the box. One line reads Arthur Bell Nicholls (1817–1906).

info.p: The box takes the person only when you choose the line from the list.

step.cmd: Leave the marriage boxes and empty. Choose .

info.p: Charlotte and Arthur had no children. You add the marriage on the page of the family.

stepresult.p: The page of the family opens.

result.p: Once you add the marriage, the of Charlotte shows her husband beside her, with m. 1854 between them.

postreq.p: Next: shows how to add the marriage.
